case: F05 ordinary canvas native pointer drag of audio and video from the asset library

productSupport.assetCard: static/js/canvas.js renderCanvasAssetLibrary sets data-kind and application/x-canvas-asset on dragstart
productSupport.canvasDrop: The board drop handler reads the asset payload and calls createImageCardFromUrl for non-workflow media
productSupport.mediaNode: createImageCardFromUrl stores video/audio in an image node's mediaKind; the node renderer shows a video preview or audio player

uiResult.assetPanel: Opened the 角色 category on an initially empty ordinary canvas.
uiResult.method: Native pointer drag of the audio card to the blank board, followed by native pointer drag of the video card to a second position.

validation: Read back the isolated canvas JSON after both native drags, refreshed the page and observed both media nodes and successful browser decode; verified both isolated fixture file sizes and SHA-256 hashes.
limits: Self-made short WAV/WebM files and the ordinary canvas asset-library drag path in the in-app browser only. No generation, paid provider, production data, or independent browser profile was exercised.
